lines: Tattha bhāganti kummāsakoṭṭhāsaṃ.
Tenāha “kummāsapiṇḍaṃ datvānā”ti.
Kummāsoti ca yavakummāso vutto.
Sesaṃ vuttanayameva.

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Abhikkantena vaṇṇenāti dutiyasuṇisāvimānaṃ.
Ettha pana apubbaṃ natthi, aṭṭhuppattiyaṃ kummāsadānameva viseso.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Abhikkantena vaṇṇena, yā tvaṃ tiṭṭhasi devate;

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Obhāsentī disā sabbā, osadhī viya tārakā.

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo, kena te idha mijjhati;

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Uppajjanti ca te bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Pucchāmi taṃ devi mahānubhāve, manussabhūtā kimakāsi puññaṃ;

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Sā devatā attamanā, moggallānena pucchitā;

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Pañhaṃ puṭṭhā viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ”.

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūtā, suṇisā ahosiṃ sasurassa gehe.

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Addasaṃ virajaṃ bhikkhuṃ, vippasannamanāvilaṃ;

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Tassa adāsahaṃ bhāgaṃ, pasannā sehi pāṇibhi;

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Kummāsapiṇḍaṃ datvāna, modāmi nandane vane.

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo, tena me idha mijjhati;

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Uppajjanti ca me bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Akkhāmi te bhikkhu mahānubhāva, manussabhūtā yamakāsi puññaṃ;

before.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Tenamhi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā, vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

after.title: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā.
